title: Grab And Move overrides Alt + Scroll function on other apps.

judgment.rationale: The issue supplies a controlled on/off comparison, and modifier capture is a plausible path, but current behavior and hook order remain unverified.
evidence: On 0.99.1 the reporter's AutoHotkey Alt+wheel mapping no longer changes volume when Grab and Move is enabled; another commenter reports DaVinci zoom interference.
The reporter notes wheel scrolling itself was restored, but the Alt modifier is not received as expected by the mapping.

In pinned source, HandleKeyboardEvent may absorb the activation modifier while HandleMouseEvent handles buttons and movement; inspect modifier replay and hook ordering: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/modules/GrabAndMove/GrabAndMove/main.cpp.

fix_assessment.rationale: The issue supplies a controlled on/off comparison, and modifier capture is a plausible path, but current behavior and hook order remain unverified.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve Alt+wheel shortcuts alongside Grab and Move
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Modifier capture or replay timing may leave the wheel consumer without the expected Alt state; this is not confirmed on current code.
plan: Reproduce the exact AHK v2 Alt+wheel mapping with Grab and Move enabled and disabled on current main.
Trace modifier down, wheel and up through the hook chain and distinguish an unconsumed wheel from the modifier state seen by AHK.
If confirmed, preserve non-drag modifier combinations without regressing drag and menu suppression; add an input-sequence regression.
verification: Alt+wheel changes volume with the module enabled and disabled; Alt drag and menu suppression remain correct.
